arguments.message: Downgrading won’t delete any of your data. Features that are only available on the higher tier will simply be hidden, and the data stays in your workspace. The only thing that can be lost is data that falls outside the retention window of the lower tier – it will age out over time, just as it would if you had started on that tier. So you can downgrade safely without worrying about immediate data loss.
